answer: The salted-egg room holds duck eggs in baskets, the brine jars standing in a row on the shelf. Proof of salted-egg maker via brined egg tally — a jar the egg-maker seals only after 29 jars hold their brine without one cracking at the shell, each sealed by the egg-maker himself. island packs each egg in salted ash and sets it in the jar. vine seals the jar lid tight and chalks the date on the side. zephyr opens a jar after a month and cracks an egg to test the yolk. Twenty-nine jars must hold their brine without one cracking at the shell, and the next still cracks where the ash ran dry.
